Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia izquierda.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales sin alteraciones actuales.
Meniscos impresionan de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial. Condropatía superficial del resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales.
Úlceras condrales focales de espesor total de la vertiente lateral y región central de la tróclea
femoral, así como también del vértice y faceta medial de la rótula con mínimos cambios óseos
secundarios.
Leve derrame articular con discreta sinovitis difusa. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y del aspecto proximal del tendón
rotuliano, sin criterios de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Discreto edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Pequeñas artefactos de susceptibilidad magnética rodeando a la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con
antecedentes.
Impresión:
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial. Condropatía superficial del resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales.
Condropatía lesiones focales grado 3-4 de la articulación patelofemoral.
Leve derrame articular con discreta sinovitis difusa.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial. Artefactos de susceptibilidad magnética
rodeando la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con antecedentes.

Izljev suprapatelarno uz vidljiv edem Hoffinog masnog tkiva.

Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenog intenziteta signala, prati se u kontinuitetu.
Kompleksna ruptura trupa i stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska dominantno na podlozi
degenerativnih promjena, sa širenjem u stražnji korijen koji je inhomogene strukture.

vidljive rupture.

znakova rupture.

umjerenih tendinopatskih promjena.
Teteive pes anserinusa i iliotibijalni trakt su primjerenog intenziteta signala.
Izmjenjen intenzitet signala pri patelarnom hvatištu tetive kvadricepsa i ligg. patele u smislu
entezopatskih promjena.
Edem posteromedijalne zglobne čahure.
Poplitealna cista veličine 21x17x39mm.
Os fabella.
Neurovaskularne strukture su primjerenog prikaza.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the lumbar knee was performed on a 3.0 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Minimal degenerative subchondral bone marrow edema is present at the lateral tibiofemoral compartment related to overlying chondrosis. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate-sized Baker cyst with slight surrounding edema likely representing leakage.

There are postoperative changes anteriorly consistent with previous arthroscopic surgery.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a diminutive appearance of the body and posterior horn consistent with previous partial meniscectomy. There is irregularity of the inner margin diffusely consistent with recurrent tear. There is moderate extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning and fissuring is present at the posterior and peripheral weightbearing aspect, with minimal degenerative subchondral bone marrow edema.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning and surface irregularity at the patella and trochlea, medial greater than lateral.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild tendinosis with diffuse thickening.
Patella tendon: Moderate tendinosis with diffuse thickening.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

A thickened medial patellar plica is present, extending into the patellofemoral compartment.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

[REDACTED]. Lateral compartment chondrosis appears new or increased. Otherwise, no significant interval change.

IMPRESSION:

1. Previous partial lateral meniscectomy with recurrent tear.
2. Chondrosis in the patellofemoral and lateral tibiofemoral compartment.
3. Quadriceps and patellar tendinosis.
4. Thickened medial patellar plica.
5. Small joint effusion. Moderate Baker cyst with evidence of leakage.

In the medial compartment, there is horizontal tear at the body and radial tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
  
 The lateral compartment, there are small radial tear at the body and large radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.8* 2.2 cm). 
  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact. 
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is anterior tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 There is grade II ligamentous sprain (partial tear) (chronic) of the lateral collateral ligament. Partial tear of the intraarticular portion, popliteus tendon. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. There are tears of the meniscopopliteal fascicles.  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Large amount of right knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is bone contusion at the posteromedial tibial plateau.   Osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.8* 2.2 cm) of right knee. 
  Horizontal tear at the body and radial tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. 
  Small radial tear at the body and large radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.

  Tears of the meniscopopliteal fascicles.

Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal kompartmanda en belirgin ve tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu, subkondral medüller fibrokistik ve fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve hipertrofik marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Çapraz bağlarda ön > arka olmak üzere mukoid dejenerasyon izleniyor. Dış yan bağ normal. İç yan bağ ekstrüde menisküs - parameniskal kistin basısı  etkisi ile yaylanmış ve çevresi ödemli. Medyale 8 mm ekstrüde medyal menisküsün arka  kökünde 13 mm 'ye varan retraksiyonla birlikte olan tam kat yırtık ve arka boynuz - gövdesi bileşkesindeki dejenerasyon ve serbest kenarında püsküllenme tarzında yırtığı telkin eden düzensizlik izleniyor. Medyal menisküs ön boynuz - gövdesi bileşkesinde yaklaşık 4.2 cm boyuta ulaşan ince septasyonlar barındıran ve sızdıran parameniskal kist izleniyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Kuadriseps ve infrapatellar yağ yastıkları ödemli. Patellar tendon proksimalinde hafif dereceli tendonozis ve paratenon ödem mevcut. Ekstensör mekanizma bunun dışında korunmuş.
